errors.evidence: The description states there are eight categories on the x-axis, but there are actually nine: “程度”、“空间”、“时间”、“形态”、“频数”、“情绪”、“状态”、“评价”和“性格”.

The description makes an unsubstantiated claim that the categories are sorted by 'Chinese character order'. The order does not follow any standard sorting method (like pinyin or stroke count), and the chart does not provide this information.
